chunks.text:
1. Overview
A dynamically managed hybrid fund that shifts allocation between equity and debt based on market valuation cues. Equity exposure can range from roughly 30 to 80 percent, so NAV moves with markets in both directions.
chunks.title: Balanced Advantage Fund

chunks.text:
2. Key Features
Minimum investment: Rs. 1,000. Liquidity classification: medium. SIP supported from Rs. 1,000 per month. Allocation shifts reviewed daily. Exit load 1 percent within 15 days only.
chunks.title: Balanced Advantage Fund

chunks.text:
3. Suitability Profile
Recommended for investors with a computed risk capacity of moderate or aggressive. Investment horizon should be at least 36 months. Aligns with goals: wealth, retirement, education. Moderate-risk investors entering equity gradually, or those uneasy with full equity volatility.
chunks.title: Balanced Advantage Fund

chunks.text:
4. Risk Factors And Warnings
Equity-leg drawdowns of 10-25 percent are historically normal. Returns are uncertain and never guaranteed.
chunks.title: Balanced Advantage Fund

chunks.text:
5. Charges Liquidity And Taxation
Expense ratio around 0.8-1.1 percent regular plan. Equity-oriented taxation: 12.5 percent LTCG beyond exemption.
chunks.title: Balanced Advantage Fund

chunks.text:
1. Overview
An open-ended debt scheme investing predominantly in AAA-rated corporate bonds, government securities and money-market instruments. Returns are market-linked and not guaranteed.
chunks.title: Corporate Bond Debt Fund

chunks.text:
2. Key Features
Minimum investment: Rs. 5,000. Liquidity classification: medium. Daily NAV, SIP from Rs. 500 per month, exit load nil beyond seven days. Credit-rating and duration risk apply.
chunks.title: Corporate Bond Debt Fund

chunks.text:
3. Suitability Profile
Recommended for investors with a computed risk capacity of conservative or moderate or aggressive. Investment horizon should be at least 12 months. Aligns with goals: wealth, safety, education. Conservative-to-moderate investors parking funds beyond one year who accept small NAV fluctuation for better post-tax yield than deposits.
chunks.title: Corporate Bond Debt Fund

chunks.text:
4. Risk Factors And Warnings
Not insured or guaranteed. A downgrade of held paper or rising-rate shock can produce negative returns over short windows.
chunks.title: Corporate Bond Debt Fund

chunks.text:
5. Charges Liquidity And Taxation
Expense ratio up to about 0.5 percent direct plan. Exit load nil after seven days. Taxation: LTCG above Rs. 1.25 lakh taxed at 12.5 percent.
chunks.title: Corporate Bond Debt Fund

chunks.text:
1. Overview
An equity-linked savings scheme with a statutory lock-in of 36 months per installment. Investments qualify for Section 80C deduction up to Rs. 1.5 lakh per year under the old tax regime.
chunks.title: ELSS Tax Saver Fund

chunks.text:
2. Key Features
Minimum investment: Rs. 500. Liquidity classification: low. Every installment locks for 36 months from its own date. After lock-in, redemption is fully at the investor's discretion.
chunks.title: ELSS Tax Saver Fund

chunks.text:
3. Suitability Profile
Recommended for investors with a computed risk capacity of moderate or aggressive. Investment horizon should be at least 36 months. Aligns with goals: tax, wealth. Tax-paying investors in the old regime with a minimum three-year commitment.
chunks.title: ELSS Tax Saver Fund

chunks.text:
4. Risk Factors And Warnings
Thirty-six-month lock-in applies even if markets fall, so exit timing is impossible. Full equity volatility applies.
chunks.title: ELSS Tax Saver Fund

chunks.text:
5. Charges Liquidity And Taxation
Expense ratio near 1.0-1.8 percent regular plan. Lock-in prevents exit-load complexity. Equity taxation applies.
chunks.title: ELSS Tax Saver Fund

chunks.text:
1. Overview
A term deposit placed with the bank for a fixed tenor at a contracted interest rate. Interest accrues quarterly and may be paid out or compounded. Tenors range from 7 days to 10 years.
chunks.title: Smart Fixed Deposit

chunks.text:
2. Key Features
Minimum investment: Rs. 5,000. Liquidity classification: medium. Premature closure permitted with a 0.5-1.0 percent rate penalty. Nomination available. Senior citizens earn 0.50 percent higher interest.
chunks.title: Smart Fixed Deposit

chunks.text:
3. Suitability Profile
Recommended for investors with a computed risk capacity of conservative or moderate or aggressive. Investment horizon should be at least 6 months. Aligns with goals: safety, wealth, education. First-time investors, emergency reserves, and capital-preservation allocations near a goal date. Suitable as the stability core of any portfolio.
chunks.title: Smart Fixed Deposit

chunks.text:
4. Risk Factors And Warnings
Premature withdrawal earns a lower rate. Interest is fully taxable at slab rate. Bank failure risk mitigated but DICGC insurance caps at Rs. 5 lakh per bank per depositor.
chunks.title: Smart Fixed Deposit

chunks.text:
5. Charges Liquidity And Taxation
No entry charge. TDS applies on interest above Rs. 40,000 per year (Rs. 50,000 for seniors) unless Form 15G/15H is filed.
chunks.title: Smart Fixed Deposit

chunks.text:
1. Overview
Indemnity health insurance covering hospitalisation for the family with cashless treatment across network hospitals, annual renewal, and restoration of sum insured on partial utilisation.
chunks.title: Comprehensive Family Health Cover

chunks.text:
2. Key Features
Minimum investment: Rs. 9,000. Liquidity classification: none. Sum insured options from Rs. 5 lakh to Rs. 1 crore. Pre and post hospitalisation covered 60 and 90 days respectively. Waiting periods apply for pre-existing conditions.
chunks.title: Comprehensive Family Health Cover

chunks.text:
3. Suitability Profile
Recommended for investors with a computed risk capacity of conservative or moderate or aggressive. Investment horizon should be at least 0 months. Aligns with goals: safety. Every household; medical inflation routinely outruns self-insurance capacity.
chunks.title: Comprehensive Family Health Cover

chunks.text:
4. Risk Factors And Warnings
Premiums increase with age band and medical inflation. Co-pay, room-rent caps and disease-specific waiting periods limit certain claims.
chunks.title: Comprehensive Family Health Cover

chunks.text:
5. Charges Liquidity And Taxation
Annual premium revisable by insurer with IRDAI approval; GST applies. No-claim bonus raises sum insured without extra premium.
chunks.title: Comprehensive Family Health Cover

chunks.text:
1. Overview
A systematic investment plan into an open-ended index fund replicating the Nifty 50 TRI. The portfolio holds the same stocks as the index, so unit value rises and falls directly with the market.
chunks.title: Nifty 50 Index Fund (SIP)

chunks.text:
2. Key Features
Minimum investment: Rs. 500. Liquidity classification: medium. Lowest expense ratio among equity funds since there is no active management. Any-day pause, step-up or stop of SIP without penalty.
chunks.title: Nifty 50 Index Fund (SIP)

chunks.text:
3. Suitability Profile
Recommended for investors with a computed risk capacity of moderate or aggressive. Investment horizon should be at least 36 months. Aligns with goals: wealth, retirement, education. Long-horizon investors preferring market returns at minimal cost over stock-picking risk.
chunks.title: Nifty 50 Index Fund (SIP)

chunks.text:
4. Risk Factors And Warnings
Full market risk: the index has fallen more than 35 percent peak-to-trough in past crises. Recovery has historically taken one to three years, which is not a promise of future recovery.
chunks.title: Nifty 50 Index Fund (SIP)

chunks.text:
5. Charges Liquidity And Taxation
Expense ratio near 0.2 percent direct. STCG 20 percent within twelve months; LTCG 12.5 percent beyond Rs. 1.25 lakh yearly gain.
chunks.title: Nifty 50 Index Fund (SIP)

chunks.text:
1. Overview
An actively managed equity fund investing at least 80 percent of assets in the top 100 listed companies by market capitalisation. Returns depend entirely on stock-market performance.
chunks.title: Blue-Chip Large-Cap Equity Fund

chunks.text:
2. Key Features
Minimum investment: Rs. 1,000. Liquidity classification: medium. Fund manager discretion adds tracking difference versus the index. SIP step-up facility available.
chunks.title: Blue-Chip Large-Cap Equity Fund

chunks.text:
3. Suitability Profile
Recommended for investors with a computed risk capacity of moderate or aggressive. Investment horizon should be at least 36 months. Aligns with goals: wealth, retirement. Moderate-to-aggressive investors comfortable with multi-year equity cycles.
chunks.title: Blue-Chip Large-Cap Equity Fund

chunks.text:
4. Risk Factors And Warnings
Manager risk on top of market risk. Drawdowns similar to the index; poor manager selection can underperform the index over long stretches.
chunks.title: Blue-Chip Large-Cap Equity Fund

chunks.text:
5. Charges Liquidity And Taxation
Expense ratio around 1.0-1.6 percent regular plan. Equity taxation as above.
chunks.title: Blue-Chip Large-Cap Equity Fund

chunks.text:
1. Overview
A contributory pension scheme regulated by PFRDA. Contributions are invested across equity, corporate bonds and government securities according to a chosen auto or active life-cycle strategy until age 60.
chunks.title: National Pension System

chunks.text:
2. Key Features
Minimum investment: Rs. 500. Liquidity classification: low. Tier-I account is locked until age 60 with partial withdrawal for defined needs after three years. Up to 75 percent equity allowed under active choice.
chunks.title: National Pension System

chunks.text:
3. Suitability Profile
Recommended for investors with a computed risk capacity of moderate or aggressive. Investment horizon should be at least 120 months. Aligns with goals: retirement, tax. Salaried earners building a dedicated retirement corpus alongside EPF, wanting extra Section 80CCD(1B) deduction of Rs. 50,000.
chunks.title: National Pension System

chunks.text:
4. Risk Factors And Warnings
Locked until 60 except narrow exceptions. Annuity purchase of at least 40 percent of the corpus at exit is mandatory and annuity rates then prevailing apply.
chunks.title: National Pension System

chunks.text:
5. Charges Liquidity And Taxation
Charge architecture under 0.1 percent per year plus record-keeping fees. Withdrawal corpus taxed as per prevailing rules; 60 percent lump sum at 60 currently exempt.
chunks.title: National Pension System

chunks.text:
1. Overview
A government-backed long-term savings scheme with a 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks. Contributions up to Rs. 1.5 lakh per year qualify for Section 80C deduction and interest is fully exempt.
chunks.title: Public Provident Fund

chunks.text:
2. Key Features
Minimum investment: Rs. 500. Liquidity classification: low. Annual contribution between Rs. 500 and Rs. 1.5 lakh. Partial withdrawal permitted from year seven; loans against balance from year three.
chunks.title: Public Provident Fund

chunks.text:
3. Suitability Profile
Recommended for investors with a computed risk capacity of conservative or moderate or aggressive. Investment horizon should be at least 180 months. Aligns with goals: retirement, safety, tax, education. Long-horizon conservative savers, especially parents earmarking education funds and retirees' spouses seeking EEE taxation.
chunks.title: Public Provident Fund

chunks.text:
4. Risk Factors And Warnings
Fifteen-year illiquidity is the primary constraint. Rates reset quarterly by the government and may drift down.
chunks.title: Public Provident Fund

chunks.text:
5. Charges Liquidity And Taxation
Zero charges. Contribution capped at Rs. 1.5 lakh per financial year across all PPF accounts.
chunks.title: Public Provident Fund

chunks.text:
1. Overview
A deposit where a fixed installment is auto-debited every month for a chosen tenor of 12 to 120 months. At maturity the depositor receives principal plus compounded interest.
chunks.title: Monthly Recurring Deposit

chunks.text:
2. Key Features
Minimum investment: Rs. 1,000. Liquidity classification: low. Installments auto-debited on a chosen day each month. One missed installment attracts a small penalty; six consecutive misses close the deposit.
chunks.title: Monthly Recurring Deposit

chunks.text:
3. Suitability Profile
Recommended for investors with a computed risk capacity of conservative or moderate or aggressive. Investment horizon should be at least 12 months. Aligns with goals: safety, education, wealth. Savers building discipline toward a dated goal such as school fees due in one to three years.
chunks.title: Monthly Recurring Deposit

chunks.text:
4. Risk Factors And Warnings
Missed installments reduce maturity value. Interest taxable at slab. Premature closure converts the deposit to a savings rate for the completed period.
chunks.title: Monthly Recurring Deposit

chunks.text:
5. Charges Liquidity And Taxation
Penalty of Rs. 50-Rs. 150 per missed installment depending on the amount. TDS rules identical to fixed deposits.
chunks.title: Monthly Recurring Deposit

chunks.text:
1. Overview
Government securities denominated in grams of gold. They pay a fixed 2.5 percent interest per annum in addition to tracking the market price of gold at redemption. Eight-year maturity with exit windows from year five.
chunks.title: Sovereign Gold Bond

chunks.text:
2. Key Features
Minimum investment: Rs. 7,000. Liquidity classification: low. Interest credited half-yearly to the bank account. Tradable on secondary market from year five. Capital gains on redemption are tax-exempt.
chunks.title: Sovereign Gold Bond

chunks.text:
3. Suitability Profile
Recommended for investors with a computed risk capacity of moderate or aggressive. Investment horizon should be at least 60 months. Aligns with goals: wealth. Investors wanting gold exposure without storage cost, sized below 15 percent of the portfolio.
chunks.title: Sovereign Gold Bond

chunks.text:
4. Risk Factors And Warnings
Gold price can fall sharply and stay down for years. Five-year minimum holding before the first exit window.
chunks.title: Sovereign Gold Bond

chunks.text:
5. Charges Liquidity And Taxation
Issued at market gold price plus zero premium; 2.5 percent yearly interest paid by RBI. Redemption proceeds exempt from capital-gains tax.
chunks.title: Sovereign Gold Bond

chunks.text:
1. Overview
A savings account linked to fixed deposits. Balances above a chosen threshold are automatically swept into FD units in multiples of Rs. 1,000 and reverse-swept when withdrawals exceed the balance.
chunks.title: Sweep-in Savings Plus Account

chunks.text:
2. Key Features
Minimum investment: Rs. 25,000. Liquidity classification: high. Fully liquid at par value up to the sweep threshold. FD leg earns deposit rates without breaking the full deposit.
chunks.title: Sweep-in Savings Plus Account

chunks.text:
3. Suitability Profile
Recommended for investors with a computed risk capacity of conservative or moderate or aggressive. Investment horizon should be at least 0 months. Aligns with goals: safety. Idle operating balances above one month of expenses that still need same-day access.
chunks.title: Sweep-in Savings Plus Account

chunks.text:
4. Risk Factors And Warnings
Swept FD units broken early earn a penalised rate. Returns lag inflation over long periods.
chunks.title: Sweep-in Savings Plus Account

chunks.text:
5. Charges Liquidity And Taxation
No account fee beyond the standard schedule of charges. Sweep operations themselves are free.
chunks.title: Sweep-in Savings Plus Account

chunks.text:
1. Overview
Pure risk-cover life insurance for a chosen sum assured and policy term. There is no maturity benefit; the nominee receives the sum assured only if the life assured passes away during the term.
chunks.title: Shield Term Life Insurance

chunks.text:
2. Key Features
Minimum investment: Rs. 6,000. Liquidity classification: none. Sum assured from Rs. 50 lakh to Rs. 5 crore. Premium rates fixed at entry for the whole term. Riders for critical illness and accident available.
chunks.title: Shield Term Life Insurance

chunks.text:
3. Suitability Profile
Recommended for investors with a computed risk capacity of conservative or moderate or aggressive. Investment horizon should be at least 0 months. Aligns with goals: safety. Any earner whose household depends on their income, especially with loans or dependents. Cover of roughly ten times annual income is a common planning benchmark.
chunks.title: Shield Term Life Insurance

chunks.text:
4. Risk Factors And Warnings
No money back at any point. Claims can be repudiated for non-disclosure of medical history at proposal stage. Premiums rise steeply if purchased late.
chunks.title: Shield Term Life Insurance

chunks.text:
5. Charges Liquidity And Taxation
Annual premium level for the term; GST applies. No surrender value exists because there is no investment component.
chunks.title: Shield Term Life Insurance
